reserveReview.rationale: At Ethereum block 26236645, hash 0xf38b2bd0053476d221004fafbc18da6ac77c23947336529b54eb1974d489280e, timestamp 2026-10-20T22:00:11Z, the complete current census contains 18 authorized markets. The original W3R48 16-market baseline at block 26122502 was independently reproduced; a successful full numeric-range delta scan through the current pin recovers exactly two additional factory registrations, CVX/ETH and frxUSD/DUSD, with no intervening SetIsMinter/SetIsBurner/SetIsIRProducer/SetIsPegKeeper or SetIsMarketCreator events. All 18 market identities return isMinter=true at the current pin. Same-block collatToken(), collatOracle(), totalCollateral(), collatDecimals() and oracle latestAnswer(true) measure $5,036,355.30149916 of protocol-oracle-marked borrower collateral. All underlying constituent identities, balances and token decimals were read at that pin. Each market mark is allocated using its pool's native normalized-balance accounting: balance times stored_rates() for fifteen NG pools, fixed decimal multipliers for two legacy pools, and price_scale for the WETH/CVX crypto pool. All 21 measured constituents are explicit; fifteen exact tracked stablecoin contract matches establish collateral dependencies, while six non-stablecoin instruments remain untracked cryptoasset exposures. This replaces the unclassified look-through residual without known-only normalization or assumed holdings. Both PegKeepers still hold exactly 20M prefunded USG and have debt()=0, so these self-token inventories remain excluded. The current collateral observation does not certify whole-liability financial reconciliation, funded redemption, custody safeguards or stressed realization. Raw numeric-pin requests, successful census ranges, responses and calculations are retained in agents/2026-10-20-safety-refinement/results/FD11-usg-current-reserve-evidence.json; the independently reproduced historical baseline remains in FD11-usg-reserve-evidence.json. CompositionAsOf is the actual current observation date, not a renewed historical portfolio.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Complete current 18-market borrower-collateral census and deployed oracle marks at Ethereum block 26236645; exact LP constituent attribution by same-block native pool accounting. Prefunded PegKeeper USG remains excluded.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete collateral book is identified at the 2026-10-20 pin. Whole-position stressed realization, custody safeguards of underlying instruments and complete native-supply financial reconciliation remain unestablished; none is inferred from LP balance/rate accounting.
